h1: Custom Fitted Stationery for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom fitted stationery in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for branded greeting cards and envelopes with a polished fit.
introHtml: Fitted stationery ensures your branded greeting cards and envelopes align perfectly, eliminating the loose, sloppy look of standard sizes. Whether you're sending holiday greetings or thank-you notes, custom fitted stationery gives a tailored, professional impression. Decorate with foil stamping or full-color print on premium cardstock for a finish that reflects your company's attention to detail.
heroAltText: Custom fitted stationery with gold foil greeting card and matching envelope
